fnol_text: My name is Felix Whitfield and I live at 755 Alder Lane, Milton, VT 05445. You can reach me on (555) 948-8736 or felix.whitfield@example.com. On 10 July 2025 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Valentina Wojcik, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2025-00046. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Whitfield on (555) 948-8736 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 10 July 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Owen McBride gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Valentina Wojcik reports lacerations to the forearm and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Felix reports bruised ribs.
